title: MemoryManagerInput
description: Input for the memory_manager tool. Dispatches one of four memory operations defined in memory.manager.

args.description: Operation-specific arguments. Shape depends on op value.

oneOf.title: load_for_generation args
oneOf.description: Load relevant memory context for the prompt generation step.

top_k.description: Maximum number of long-memory pairs to retrieve.

oneOf.title: append_long_memory args
oneOf.description: Append a prompt pair to the long-term memory store.

prompt_pair_id.description: ID of the prompt pair to append.

oneOf.title: write_pair args
oneOf.description: Persist a prompt pair to the round memory store.

oneOf.title: prune_long_memory args
oneOf.description: Remove low-scoring entries from the long-term memory store.

keep_top_k.description: Number of top entries to retain.
